$description: LEAPWare Light. The default theme. A theme is three generative inputs plus an optional curve override — base colour, accent colour, contrast multiplier — and nothing else. There is no colour value in this file, and there must never be one: a theme that names a colour directly is a theme that can name a colour that fails the contrast manifest.

base.$description: The neutral ramp. Chroma is small and non-zero on purpose: a completely achromatic grey next to a chromatic accent reads as dirty rather than as neutral.

accent.$description: Focus ring, links, selected-solid fills. CHANGED 2026-08-04 from hue 252 / chroma 0.155. The blue read as generic product chrome; petrol is the identity chosen for an operator instrument. Chroma drops because teal cannot hold 0.155 at these lightnesses inside sRGB, and a value the gamut mapper has to pull back is a value the contrast checker did not measure.

contrast.$description: Multiplier on each step's distance from step 1. 1.0 is the curve as authored.
